: Barrick (ABX) and Newmont expanded Nevada Gold Mines, adding Fourmile, Fiberline and Mike. Newmont paid Barrick $1.95B. The combined Nevada complex now totals ~100M oz gold.
Barrick ABX Targets Raised By Banks
: TD reaffirmed Buy on Barrick (ABX) with C$59 target; RBC kept Outperform and raised its target to US$53 from US$49 — analyst price targets and ratings for ABX.
